text.body: <4> atha caturtho'dhyāyaḥ dvitīye prapāṭhake daśamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ śrīkalpasūtropagranthakṛto guruvarān bhaje | śrīgārgyamaśakadrāhyāyaṇakātyāyanāhvayān || atra kṣudrakalpasūtre pūrvatrikeṇa pratipadādibhiḥ sarvaprakatibhūta jyotiṣṭomavicārānuktvā ataḥ paramuttaratrikeṇāhargaṇaprakatibhūta dvādaśāhavicārān vivakṣurbhagavān gārgyamaśakācāryo dvādaśāhāntargata pṛṣṭhyaṣaḍahasya dvāviṃśatidhā bhinnān vicārān śākhāntarīyabrāhmaṇānusāreṇa vaktumārabhate - athātaḥ ṣaḍahasya pṛṣṭhato vicārāḥ ||1|| atha sarvaprakṛtibhūtajyotirvicārānantaram | ataḥ jyotirvicārasya vṛttatvāt hetoḥ ṣaḍahasya pṛṣṭhato vicārāḥ ārabhyanta iti śeṣaḥ | pṛṣṭheṣveva sāmabhedena vividhakalpanāvicāraḥ | taduktaṃ nidāne - atha pṛṣṭhānāmanukalpa iti brāhmaṇoktasya - pṛṣṭhyaṣaḍahānantaraṃ pravṛttatvādeteṣāmanukalpatvam| na tu vrīhinīvāravat pratinidhitvam | vicāraśabdenaiva vividhakalpasyoktatvāt tena prākṛtaṣaḍahena sahaite ṣaḍahavicārāḥ vrīhiyavavat vikalpante | te ca dvāviṃśatiḥ | ādyaḥ pṛṣṭhaystomaḥ| dvitīyo nānāpṛṣṭhyaḥ | prākṛtaḥ parokṣapṛṣṭhyastṛtīyaḥ| sarvaparokṣapṛṣyścaturthaḥ | ubhaya parokṣapṛṣṭhyaḥ pañcamaḥ| upāṅkyapṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ| anvāhāryapṛṣṭhyaḥ saptamaḥ| dharmabhedenopāṅkyapṛṣṭhānvāhāryapṛṣṭhāvaṣṭamanavamau| purastājjyotiḥṣaḍaho daśamaḥ | upariṣṭājjyotiḥṣaḍaha ekādaśaḥ | bṛhadrathantarapurastājjyotiḥṣaḍaho dvādaśāhaḥ| bṛhadrathantaropariṣṭājjyotiḥ ṣaḍahastrayodaśaḥ | parokṣāparkyapṛṣṭhyaścaturdaśaḥ | pratyakṣāparkyapṛṣṭhyaḥ pañcadaśaḥ | parokṣaprākyapṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣoḍaśaḥ | pratyakṣaprāṅkyapṛṣṭhyaḥ saptadaśaḥ | bṛhadrathantarapṛṣṭhyo'nugṛhītapṛṣṭhyo'ṣṭādaśaḥ | bṛhadrathantarapṛṣṭhyo'nu gṛhītaparokṣapṛṣṭhya ekānnaviṃśaḥ| nānāpṛṣṭhyo'nugṛhītabṛhadrathantaro viṃśaḥ | nānāpṛṣṭhyo'nugṛhītabṛhadrantaraparokṣatara ekaviṃśaḥ | brahmasāmapṛṣṭhyo dvāviṃśaḥ ||1|| [pṛṣṭhayastomaḥ] tatra prathamasvarūpamāha - bṛhadrathantarapṛṣṭhaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ samūḍhaḥ ||2|| iti | ṣaṭsvapyahaḥsu rathantarabṛhatī eva vyatyāsena pṛṣṭhe yasya ṣaḍahasya sa tathoktaḥ | brāhmaṇe vyūḍhasyaivoktatvāt tadvikṛtitvādetasyāpi vyūḍhatvaprāptāvāha samūḍha iti ||2|| pṛṣṭhyastomasaptarātravat klṛptimāha - tasya kalpo yathā pṛṣṭhyastomasya yadyāhīnikaḥ ||3|| iti | gatam ||3|| dvādaśāhasyāhīnasatrobhayātmakatvāt tadaṅgatvāt pṛṣṭhyaṣaḍahasya tatra tatra bhūte viśeṣamāha - caturtho'dhyāyaḥ - pṛṣṭhyaṣaḍahānukalpāḥ atha yadi sātrikaḥ sa eva san gaurīvitasvaraḥ ||4|| iti | spaṣṭam | atra caturthe'hani kalpakāramatānnānadastotrīye gaurīvitaṃ ṣoḍaśisāma kāryam | yadvā | indraṃ juṣasveti svarāṭsu gaurīvitaṃ ṣoḍaśisāma | taduktaṃ nidāne - atha bṛhadrathantarapṛṣṭhe dvādaśāha ityupakramya khaṇḍānte ete na manyante svarāja eveha pratyetavyāḥ | etā hi prākṛtāśca bhavanti | nyāyatarāścaitāścaivānādeśe sarvatra kratuṣu pratiyantyetenāvicchinnasya bṛhadrathantarapṛṣṭhaḥ ṣaḍahasya ṣoḍaśistotrīyo vyākhyāto yaścaiva ṣaḍahavicāreṣu yaśca saṃsatsviti yaśca saṃsatsviti iti | spaṣṭam ||4|| [nānāpṛṣṭhayaḥ] dvitīyasvarūpamāha - athāto nānāpṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ ||5|| iti | nānāvidhāni nānāpṛṣṭhāni| teṣāṃ samūhaḥ nānāpṛṣṭhyaḥ | pṛṣṭhādupasaṃkhyānam iti yan pratyayaḥ | rathantarabṛhadvairūpavairājaśākvararaivatāni pṛṣṭhāni ||5|| samūḍho vā vyūḍho vā ||6|| iti | śākhāntarīyamatāt ||6|| asmadbrāhmaṇarītyā ca samūḍhavyūḍhayoḥ aniyamamudbhāvya niyamamāha - samūḍhastveva ||7|| iti | tuśabdaḥ pakṣāntaravyāvṛttyarthaḥ| evakāro'vadhāraṇārthaḥ | etasya ṣaḍahasya ṣaḍbhirahobhinirvartyamānatvāt navarātrāpūrtervicchinnatvāt triṣṭupacchandaso vyūḍhābhāvācca samūḍha eva jyāyān | yatra sachandomaḥ pṛṣṭhyaḥ ṣaḍahastatra vyūḍhasamūḍhayorvikalpaḥ | yatra vicchandomastatra samūḍha evetyācāryasyāśayaḥ | taduktaṃ nidāne - tadapyevamiva brāhmaṇaṃ bhavati | narte chandomebhyaḥ pṛṣṭhyo vyūhamānaśaḥ iti ||7|| klṛptimāha - tasya kalpo yathartūnāṃ ṣaḍahasya yadyāhīnikaḥ ||8|| iti | spaṣṭam ||8|| atha yadi sātrikaḥ sa eva san gaurīvitasvaraḥ ||9|| iti | gatam ||9|| [parokṣapṛṣṭhayaḥ] tṛtīyasvarūpamāha - athātaḥ parokṣapṛṣṭhaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ ||10|| iti | parokṣe bṛhadrathantare pṛṣṭhe yasya sa tathoktaḥ ||10|| klṛptimāha - tasya kalpaḥ | prathamasyāhno'bhi tvā śūra nonuma iti kaṇvarathantaraṃ pṛṣṭham | dvitīyasyāhnaḥ - tvāmiddhi havāmaha caturtho'dhyāyaḥ - pṛṣṭhayaṣaḍahānukalpāḥ iti bṛhannidhanaṃ vārkajambham | kaṇvabṛhadvā | ā tvā sahasramāśatam ityeteṣāṃ dvitīyam | prajñātapṛṣṭha uttaraścaturahaḥ ||11|| iti | ā tvā sahasramiti vacanaṃ kaṇvabṛhato yonitvapradarśanārtham | na tvatra stotrīyārtham | prajñātapṛṣṭha iti vairūpavairājaśākvaravāravantīyāni prajñātāni pratyakṣāṇi yasmin tṛtīyādicaturahe sa tathoktaḥ ||11|| [sarvaparokṣapṛṣṭhyaḥ] caturthasvarūpamāha - athātaḥ sarvaparokṣapṛṣṭhaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ ||12|| iti | sarvāṇi rathantarabṛhadvairūpavairājaśākvararaivatāni parokṣāṇi pṛṣṭhāni yasya sa tathoktaḥ ||12|| ṣaṇṇāṃ pṛṣṭhānāṃ parokṣasāmānyāha - tasya kalpaḥ | ete eva prathamadvitīyayorahnoḥ pṛṣṭhe ||13|| iti | kaṇvarathantarakaṇvabṛhatī kaṇvarathantarabṛhannidhanavārkajambhe vā ||13|| tṛtīyasyāhno - yadyāva indra te śatam iti hrasvābṛhadopaśā | antarikṣaṃ vā ||14|| iti | spaṣṭam ||14|| antarikṣasya loke'ñjovairūpamanu kalpayet ||15|| iti | mādhyaṃdinapavamāne abhi somāsa iti tṛce'ntarikṣasya sthāne'ñjovairūpaṃ gāyedityarthaḥ ||15|| pṛṣṭhasthāne pakṣāntareṇa sāmāntaramāha mahāvaiṣṭambhaṃ vā ||16|| iti | yad dyāva iti tṛca eva ||16|| saṃcāradoṣaparihārārthaṃ brahmaṇaḥ pṛṣṭhe sāmāntaraṃ vidhatte - mahāvaiṣṭambhasya loke'bhinidhanaṃ kāṇvam ||17|| | iti | vayaṃ gha tveti tṛca eva ||17|| caturthasyāhnaḥ - pibā somamindra mandatu tvetyṛṣabhovairājaḥ sahodairgha tamasaṃ vā hāu pibetyetat ||18|| iti | yonau sahodairghatamasadvaye dvitīyaṃ geyamityarthaḥ ||18|| sāmāntaramāha - vasiṣṭhasya vā vairājam agniṃ nara ityetayoruttaram ||19|| iti | spaṣṭam ||16|| pañcamasyāhnas trikadrukeṣu mahiṣo yavāśiram iti nityavatsāḥ ||20|| iti | spaṣṭam | etāsu śakvarīsthapracetanapracetayayoḥ pratyakṣapadayonidhanāt nātyantaparokṣaṃ nityavatsānāmiti ||20|| caturthodhyāyaḥ - pṛṣṭhayaṣaḍahānukalpāḥ sāmāntaramāha atīṣaṅgāṇāṃ vā prathamam - indrāyāhi citrabhāno yadindracitrama iha netyetāsu gāyatrīṣu cānuṣṭupsu ca ||21|| iti | gatam | gāyatryanuṣṭubhormelanāt saptapadātvena śakvarītvāt simānāṃ pārokṣyameteṣāṃ susaṃgatam | vidā maghavannityetāsu pratyakṣāsvṛkṣu anyasya sāmno'bhāvāt ṛgantareṣu sāmāntaraṃ kalpitamācāryeṇa | taduktaṃ nidāne na tu pañcame bhedānna hi mahānāmnīṣvanyad iti | sūtre ca - na hyetāsvanyat sāmāpadyate'pi havā pṛṣṭhastotrīyeṣu parokṣāṇi kurvannaitāsu nityavatsāḥ karoti iti ||21|| ṣaṣṭhasyāhro vāravantīyaṃ pṛṣṭham ||22|| iti | gatam ||22|| nanu prākṛtaṣaḍahe vāravantīyasyaiva pratyakṣapṛṣṭhatvāt atra parokṣapṛṣṭhatvavidhānaṃ kathamiti cet | maivam | sarvatra revatīnāmeva pratyakṣatvāt | taittirīyādiśākhāsvapi ṣaṭpṛṣṭhagrahaṇe revatīnāmeva grahaṇāt vāravantīyasya revatīrṇa iti tṛce pārokṣyameva | ata eva mādhyaṃdinapavamāne revatīnāṃ pratyakṣatvāt tatsthāne parokṣaṃ sāmāntaramāha - revatīnāṃ loke dārḍhacyutam ||23|| iti | gatam | dārḍhacyutasya nidhanatvāt prākṛtavat jāmidoṣābhāvāt ||23|| aiḍena bṛhatīmārabhante iti śrutyanugrahārthamaukṣṇorandhrayorvyatyāsamāha - vipariharatyaukṣṇorandhre ||24|| iti ||24|| iti dvitīye prāpaṭhake daśamaḥ khaṇḍaḥ || 0|| ekādaśaḥ khaṇḍaḥ [ubhayaparokṣapṛṣṭhyaḥ] pañcamasvarūpamāha - athāta ubhayataḥ parokṣapṛṣṭhaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ ||1|| iti ||1|| ubhayaśabdaṃ svayameva vyācaṣṭe - ṛktaścaiva sāmataśca ||2|| iti ||2|| klṛptimāha - tasya kalpaḥ | prathamasyāhno'bhitvā pūrvapītaye iti kaṇvarathantaraṃ pṛṣṭham ||3|| dvitīyasyāhnas - tvaṃ hyehi cerava iti bṛhannidhanaṃ vārkajambham | kaṇvabṛhadvā | caturtho'dhyāyaḥ - pṛṣṭhyaṣaḍahānukalpāḥ ā tvā sahasramāśatam ityeteṣāṃ dvitīyam ||4|| tṛtīyasyāhno yadindra yāvatastvam iti hrasvā bṛhadopaśā | antarikṣaṃ vā ||5|| antarikṣasya loke'ñjovairūpamanukalpayet | | mahāvaiṣṭambhaṃ vā ||6|| mahāvaiṣṭambhasya loke'bhinidhanaṃ kāṇvam ||7|| caturthasyāhnaḥ - śrudhī havaṃ vipipānasyādrer ityṛṣabhovairājaḥ sahodairghatamasaṃ vā hāu pibetyetat ||8|| vasiṣṭhasya vā vairājam agniṃ nara ityetayoruttaram ||9|| pañcamasyāhnaḥ - proṣvasmai puroratham iti nityavatsāḥ ||10|| atīṣaṅgāṇāṃ vā prathamam indrāyāhi citrabhāno yadindra citrama iha netyetāsu gāyatrīṣvanuṣṭupsu ca ||11|| ṣaṣṭhasthāhnorevām̐ idrevata stoteti vāravantīyaṃ pṛṣṭham ||12|| revatīnāṃ loke dārḍhacyutam ||13|| vipariharatyaukṣṇorandhre ||14|| iti | pūrvavad vyākhyeyam | proṣvasmā iti tṛcasya svata eva saptapadātvāt śakvarīpārokṣyaṃ saṃgatameva ||14|| iti dvitīye prapāṭhake ekādaśaḥ khaṇḍaḥ ||15|| dvādaśaḥ khaṇḍaḥ [upāṅyapṛṣṭhyānvāhāryapṛṣṭhyau] ṣaṣṭhasaptamayoḥ svarūpamāha - - athāta upāṅkyapṛṣṭhaścānvāhāryapṛṣṭhaśca ṣaḍahau ||1|| iti | aṅkaśabdaḥ sthānavācī | upa pṛṣṭhasya samīpe mādhyaṃdinapavamāne aṅkaṃ sthānamarhantīti upāṅkyāni | tāni pṛṣṭhāni yasmin sa tathoktaḥ | anu hotuḥ pṛṣṭhasya paścāt ārbhave āhāryāṇi kalpyāni pṛṣṭhāni yasmin sa tathoktaḥ ||1|| klṛptimāha - tayoḥ kalpaḥ | pratyakṣāṇi pṛṣṭhāni pratyakṣeṣu pṛṣṭhastotrīyeṣu parokṣāṇi mādhyaṃdineṣu | bṛhatīṣu pañcānāmahnām | gāyatrīṣu ṣaṣṭhasya| sa upāṅkyapṛṣṭhaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ ||2|| iti | spaṣṭam | asya klṛptiḥ | atra nidānam - atha pṛṣṭhānāmanukalpaḥ| prathame'hani rathantaraparokṣe triṇidhanamadhyenidhanayoḥ sthāne tṛcasthe syātām | pratiṣṭhoktohagīti caturtho'dhyāyaḥ - pṛṣṭhyaṣaḍahānukalpāḥ brahmarahasyāpacitiṃ tasmāt bṛhadrathantara ekarcce na kurvanti iti | prathamasyāhnaḥ - pra somāso vipaścita iti gāyatrāśvasomasāmāni sāmatṛcaḥ | pra soma devavītaya iti kaṇvarathantaraṃ tisṛṣu | pra tu dravetyauśanamantyaṃ tisṛṣu | athavā atra nidānasūtraṃ nityairvā saha ekarccāḥ| yajñagauṅgavamadhyo vā bṛhatyāṃ sāmatṛcaḥ iti | pra somāso vipaścita iti gāyatrāśvasomasāmāni sāmatṛcaḥ| pra soma deva iti kaṇvarathantarapajrayaudhājayāni sāmatṛcaḥ | kaṇvarathantaragauṅgavayaudhājayāni vā | auśanamantyaṃ tisṛṣu | samānamitarat prathamena | evaṃ satrāhīnabhūte dvādaśāhe gavāmayane ca| abhīvartakāleyānukalpe tu atra nidānaṃ prathame'hani rathantarābhīvartayaudhājayāni sāmatṛcaḥ | arthājjāmivratagarbhivad iti | mādhyaṃdine bṛhatyāṃ pra soma deveti kaṇvarathantarābhīvartayaudhājayāni sāmatṛca iti viśeṣaḥ | yadvā atra nidānam - sarve vaikarccāḥ | nava ca bṛhatyāṃ pajragauṅgavābhyāṃ vyavadhāya trīn prathamāyāmeveti | pra soma devavītaya iti kaṇvarathantarapajre prathamāyām | abhīvartagauṅgavayaudhājayāni sāmatṛcaḥ | auśanamantyamekasyām | iti viśeṣaḥ | atra mādhyaṃdinapavamāne'pi pṛṣṭhadharmāḥ kāryāḥ| taduktaṃ nidāne kartavyā ityācāryāḥ saṃprayogāddhyeṣāmete dharmā bhavantītyathāpi sthānādapetanāṃ kriyamāṇān paśyāmaḥ iti || dvitīyasyāhnaḥ | atra nidānam āgantūni pratyahaṃ dairghaśravasamaidhātithapūrvābhiśavahārāyaṇakaulmalabarhiṣāṇi iti | mādhyaṃdine bṛhatyāṃ punānaḥ someti aiḍamāyāsyatriṇidhanamāyāsyadairghaśravasāni sāmatṛcaḥ | kaṇvabṛhattisṛṣu | bṛhannidhanavārkajambhaṃ vā | samānamitarat dvitīyena | abhīvartakāleyānukalpe tu atra nidānaṃ dvitīye tadādibārhatādyādābhīvartakāleye| yathā jānāmi iti | asyārthaḥ | dvitīye'hani tadādi āgantvādi bṛhadādi sāmatṛca ityarthaḥ | bārhatādyāditi | bṛhatyāmutpannaṃ sāma bārhatam | bārhatādyāt aiḍamāyāsyābhīvartakāleyāni sāmatṛca ityarthaḥ | yathā jānāmīti | gavāmayane prākṛtaṣaḍahe aiḍamāyāsyābhīvartakāleyāni sāmatṛco yathā kalpakāreṇa klṛptastathā jānāmīti | bṛhatyāṃ punānaḥ someti aiḍamāyāsyābhīvarta kāleyāni sāmatṛcaḥ| kaṇvabṛhaddairghaśravasatriṇidhanamāyāsyāni sāmatṛcaḥ | bṛhannidhanavārkajambhadairghaśravasatriṇidhanamāyāsyāni vā | iti viśeṣaḥ | atra mādhyaṃdinapavamāne'pi pṛṣṭhadharmāḥ kāryāḥ || tṛtīyāsyāhnaḥ | atra nidānam - āgantu pṛṣṭhaṃ cānta iti | abhi someti paurumadgaṃ prathamāyām | gautamāñjovairūpamaidhātithāni sāmatṛcaḥ | antarikṣaṃ tisṛṣu | āṣkāraṇidhanamadhyāsyāyām iti | yadvā bṛhatyāmabhi someti paurumadgaṃ prathamāyām | gautamāntarikṣamaidhātithāni sāmatṛcaḥ| hrasvā bṛhadopaśā tisṛṣu | āṣkāraṇidhanamadhyāsyāyāmiti | yadvā atra nidānaṃ nidhanavaccetpṛṣṭhaṃ tṛtīye caturtho'dhyāyaḥ - pṛṣṭhyaṣaḍahānukalpāḥ bṛhatyāmādyādviparīte iti | abhi someti paurumadgaṃ prathamāyām | mahāvaiṣṭambhaṃ tisṛṣu | maidhātithāntarikṣagautamāni sāmatṛcaḥ | āṣkāraṇidhanamadhyāsyāyām | vayaṃ gha tveti abhinidhanaṃ kāṇvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ| samānamitarat tṛtīyena | abhīvartakāleyānukalpe tu atra nidānam - tato anidhanavat pṛṣṭhaṃ tṛtīyapañcamayorgāyatramekasyām | dvitīyatṛtīyayorahnor iti | asyārthaḥ | tṛtīyapañcamayorahnoranidhanavat nidhanarahitamaiḍaṃ sāma pṛṣṭhaṃ cet bṛhatyāṃ dvitīyatṛtīyayoḥ sāmnorekarcakaraṇaṃ kāryamiti | uccā ta iti gāyatramekasyām |
